description: CollectDateTime over short phone calls: appointment slots, delivery windows, callback times, travel dates, deadlines and availability windows. Dates and times are recoverable values, so the confirmation is usually the resolution itself, saying the relative date out loud as a real date, rather than a read-back gate. A date and the time it lands at count as one value and are collected in one beat.

subtle: Resolve a relative date aloud to the actual date, and let that resolution be the confirmation. No right? after it.
Settle an AM or PM ambiguity in one beat: Eight, morning or evening?
One value, one beat: never confirm the date and then separately confirm the time.
Name a time zone once, at the moment it matters, then use your end or your time.
Narrow a window by offering, not interrogating: Five thirty, or we keep it overnight.
Rotate strategies field to field: echo-and-advance, bare value-as-question, silent accept, closing summary, one-beat correction.
An agent turn's first word repeats at most twice in a call, never in consecutive agent turns.
Each check tag appears at most twice, and at least two fields carry no tag at all.
Contractions throughout, short clauses, no em dashes, no praise, no status phrases, no I heard, no chatbot closer.
non_subtle_tells: One template on every field: Just to confirm X, is that correct?
Double gating: is that right? followed by and shall I book that?
The date confirmed, then the time confirmed separately, as two round trips.
Restating the full time zone name on every turn, ante meridiem and post meridiem for ordinary clock times.
The same canned ack every turn: Got it, Got it, Got it.
Praise on trivial answers, status phrases like has been recorded, kindly and I will now proceed, and a chatbot closer.
